name: How can I prevent mold growth after water damage in my apartment?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent mold growth after water damage in my apartment?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent mold growth after water damage, immediate and thorough drying of all affected areas is essential. Remove standing water promptly. Use dehumidifiers, fans, and open windows if outdoor humidity is low to encourage air circulation. Dispose of porous materials like drywall, insulation, and carpeting that have been saturated for more than 24-48 hours, as they are difficult to dry completely and are prone to mold. Professional restoration services can ensure proper drying and apply antimicrobial treatments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by drying affected areas thoroughly and quickly, removing standing water, and disposing of saturated porous materials within 24-48 hours.
